scope: Consider only a demonstrated container, OS-package or IaC coverage gap beyond the baseline.
prerequisites: Evidence of useful uncovered container/OS/IaC coverage.
Incident-informed verified release provenance, binary/rule/database/license digests and freshness receipts.
Explicit offline telemetry/version/database/module/VEX/registry/egress controls and resource limits.
Exact selected synthetic targets and execution authority after preservation.
inputs: Positive and negative fictional seeds with expected detector/rule outcomes.
Same approved file/change/blob/range denominator and limits for baseline and challenger.
Sanitized selected configuration only for AgentShield; approved scanner originals remain isolated from models.
metrics: Unique independently confirmed findings beyond baseline.
False positives and missed seeded positives against independently fixed expectations.
Complete/partial/skipped file and original range coverage.
Wall and CPU seconds, peak resident bytes, bounded output bytes and timeout/exit status.
acceptance: Additional useful coverage and acceptable false-positive/resource cost must be evidenced; no threshold or benchmark outcome is invented here. Target clearance remains separate.
receipts: Actual command/environment/profile identity and result/time/actor/artifact location.
Native egress/credential/mode controls, complete denominator accounting and independent findings disposition.
unavailable_result: NOT_QUALIFIED; keep deferred and baseline unchanged.
documented_version_controls: Research pin v0.76.1 is not current release trust or a verified executable.
Prior research records malicious v0.69.4, DockerHub 0.69.5/0.69.6 and Action-tag incidents; do not infer that every later release is compromised.
--offline-scan alone is insufficient; documented --disable-telemetry and --skip-version-check address check.trivy.dev.
Independently qualify local vulnerability/Java/check databases, updates, Maven/Terraform modules, VEX, registries and denied egress.

research_source.qualification_limit: Historical research identity only; not current asset verification, endorsement, entitlement or execution permission.

thresholds: Independent owner-approved thresholds fixed before any comparison; none adopted here.
